quiet.speaker: Ruth
quiet.text: Pastor Reece used to say the garden was how you learn who'll show up.

busy.speaker: Ruth
busy.text: You've got enough people waiting. The plot isn't going anywhere.

ask.speaker: Ruth
ask.text: This plot on Maple Lane still wants hands. Clear the weeds if they need it, and plant with the neighbor. The church garden is a different patch.

accepted.speaker: Ruth
accepted.text: When it's in the ground, come find me. I water if I'm walking by. I don't hover.

later.speaker: Ruth
later.text: Seed keeps. The soil doesn't mind waiting a day.

wait.speaker: Ruth
wait.text: The weeds first, then seed with the neighbor. This plot, not the church garden.

deliver.speaker: Ruth
deliver.text: It's in the ground. That's how you learn who'll show up. I put extra carrot seed in your pack.

done.speaker: Ruth
done.text: The garden's started. I'll water if I'm out this way.
